title: Share your salon
intro: Bring your regular customers to Clozest: send them your salon's link, or put the poster up at your counter. They book a time and come without waiting.
customersSee: Opening it, customers see your salon, services and prices, and book a time. The first time, they sign in with their mobile number.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. The link is selected above: press and hold it to copy.
message: Book your time at {salon} on Clozest, no waiting at the salon: {link}
posterHint: Print it and put it up where customers wait or pay. Black and white, fits A4 or A5 paper.
posterAlt: Poster for {salon}: scan to book your time
posterFailed: Couldn't make the poster on this phone.
notLiveBody: Your link and poster start working on the day our team approves your salon. Until then a customer opening the link would only see "No such salon", so there is nothing to share yet. We'll send you a message when your salon is live.
suspendedTitle: Your salon is off the app for now
suspendedBody: Customers opening your link now see "No such salon". Sharing comes back here as soon as your salon is live again.
hiddenNow: Right now customers can't find your salon in the app. Anyone opening your link sees your salon but can't book.
paused: Online bookings are paused until {time}. Customers opening your link now see your salon but can't pick a time.
setupRowSub: Send your link on WhatsApp, or print a poster
notReadyServices: Customers will see your salon but can't book yet: add your services and prices.
notReadyBarbers: Customers will see your salon but can't book yet: add your barbers.
notReadyHours: Customers will see your salon but can't book yet: give a barber his services and weekly hours.
notReadyAskOwner: Ask {name} to set this up. You can still share the link now.
notReadyShareAnyway: You can still share the link now: it works as soon as this is done.
shareFailed: Couldn't share the poster. Free some space on the phone and try again.
posterSaved: Saved in your phone's Pictures › Clozest. Print it from there.
saveFailed: Couldn't save the poster. Free some space on the phone and try again.
